lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Before we go any further on pricing, I want to know what we're up against.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Same. I keep hearing numbers thrown around but I've never actually checked them.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I mean the meal planning apps, the fridge scanners, that whole crowd.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. And whether they charge monthly or do the one time unlock thing.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Monthly, mostly, I think. But I'd rather not guess at this stage.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, let's not. We've been guessing at it for two weeks.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Sotto, what do the main competitors charge per month?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Good. Let's see what comes back before we argue about our own number.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Because if they're all clustered in one place, we either match it or we have a reason not to.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And if there's a gap in the middle, that's interesting too.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Right. A gap usually means nobody's figured out how to make that tier work.

wakeQuestions.question: what do the main competitors charge per month?
